source: Big Data Bowl 2025 (NFL 2022 weeks 1-9): plays.csv, player_play.csv, players.csv; PFF charting labels

definitions.cohort: plays.csv rows not nullified by penalty (playNullifiedByPenalty != 'Y'), not spikes (qbSpike TRUE) and not kneels (qbKneel != 0). Sections 1-3 keep dropbacks (isDropback TRUE: passes, sacks and scrambles); section 4 and coverageCalls.allPlaysIncludingRuns also report every play.
definitions.shares: Fractions of plays (or of defender-snaps where stated) in the group; n is the group size. Coverage shares exclude plays without a pff_passCoverage label (dataChecks.dropbacksWithoutCoverageLabel).
definitions.coverageLabel: PFF pff_passCoverage as charted. families pool Cover-3/Seam/Cloud Left/Cloud Right/Double Cloud as Cover-3, Cover-1 and Cover-1 Double as Cover-1, Cover 6-Left and Cover-6 Right as Cover-6, Red Zone and Goal Line together; Bracket, Prevent and Miscellaneous stay separate.
definitions.receiverAlignment: plays.csv receiverAlignment; 2x0, 3x0, 1x0, 4x2 and 3x3 are pooled as other.
definitions.fieldZone: Yards from the offense's own goal line y: yardlineNumber when yardlineSide is the possession team, 100 - yardlineNumber when it is the opponent, 50 when yardlineSide is NA (the 50). Cross-checked against absoluteYardlineNumber (= y + 10 moving right or 110 - y moving left; dataChecks). own<20: y < 20; mid20-79; redZone80-94; goal95+: y >= 95 (inside the opponent 5).
definitions.offensePersonnel: Offensive players on the field from player_play.csv with players.csv roster positions: RB+FB count then TE count ('11' = 1 RB, 1 TE, 3 WR). '6+OL' = six or more T/G/C; 'other' = anything else (two QBs, defender on offense). In coverageCalls, groups with fewer than 20 dropbacks are pooled as rare.
definitions.defenderGroups: Roster positions: DL = DE, DT, NT; LB = ILB, MLB, OLB, LB; CB; S = SS, FS, DB (one roster DB, used as a slot/box defender). offBallLB = ILB, MLB. OLB is reported separately where it matters because 3-4 OLBs are edge rushers; the one roster 'LB' is an edge rusher and is handled as an OLB.
definitions.defensePersonnel: Count of CB + S on the field: <=3 heavy, 4 base, 5 nickel, 6 dime, 7+ quarter. dlLbDb is the DL-LB-DB count string (LB includes OLB, so a 3-4 base front with two edge OLBs reads 3-4-4).
definitions.edgeOlb: An OLB (or roster LB) whose initial-rush rate over all his dropback snaps in the sample is >= 0.5 (a 3-4 outside linebacker or wide edge); other OLBs are treated as off-ball. Snap-weighted OLB rush-rate histogram in dataChecks.
definitions.role: Per defender per play: RUSH if wasInitialPassRusher == 1, else pff_defensiveCoverageAssignment, or NONE when that is NA. Assignment codes (PFF): MAN man; 2L/2R Cover-2 deep half; 3L/3M/3R Cover-3 deep third; 4IL/4IR/4OL/4OR Cover-4 inside/outside quarter; CFL/CFR curl-flat; HCL/HCR hook-curl; HOL hole/robber; FL/FR flat; DF deep free; PRE prevent.
definitions.perPlay: For each role, mean defenders per play and the share of plays with 0, 1, 2, ... defenders in that role.
definitions.topRoleSets: The whole defense's role multiset per play (e.g. 'RUSHx4 3L 3M 3R CFL CFR HCL HCR'), most common first.
definitions.frontDrops: Share of plays with at least one DE/DT/NT not rushing (dlDropShare), with an edge OLB not rushing, with either, and with any OLB not rushing (upper bound: includes 4-3 off-ball OLBs). droppedDlRoles: roles of the DE/DT/NT who did not rush.
definitions.rushers: Count of defenders with wasInitialPassRusher == 1 on the play. Plays where any defender's flag is NA are left out of rush statistics (dataChecks.dropbacksMissingRusherFlags).
definitions.simulatedPressure: 4 or fewer rushers, at least one off-ball LB/CB/S rusher, and a front player dropping. dlOnly (primary): the dropper is a DE/DT/NT and OLB rushers do not count as the extra rusher. withEdgeOlb: edge OLBs count as front players (dropper) and off-ball OLBs count as the extra rusher. anyOlbAsDropper: any non-rushing OLB counts as the dropper (upper bound).
definitions.call: blitz (5+ rushers); simulated (dlOnly definition); standard = 4 or fewer rushers and not simulated. Detail splits standard into 4 rushers and 3 or fewer, and blitz into 5 and 6+.
definitions.pressureRate: Share of plays with causedPressure TRUE for any defender (PFF hurry, hit or sack).
definitions.sackRate: Share of plays with passResult S.
definitions.medianTimeToThrow: Median plays.csv timeToThrow (seconds) over plays where it is recorded (throws).
definitions.notAvailable: Defenders in the box and alignment depth are not in these files (they need tracking); not reported.
